reviews.text:
We are so grateful to the team at Animal Ark for the exceptional care they give our 17 year-old dog.  Everyone looks after her with genuine compassion and empathy.
Dr. Cieply’s extensive knowledge, the kindness and experience of vet tech Carrie, and the entire front desk team, especially Anna and Megan make going to the vet a joy. When something comes up unexpectedly, they make every effort to fit her in. Having that support as she gets older means so much to both of us.

It’s clear that they truly care about her, and we feel fortunate to have such a trusting team looking after her. Thank you, Animal Ark, for treating our girl with so much kindness and love.

Brought our two kitties with very different personalities in for their first post-adoption appointment, & Dr. Tran & the entire team were WONDERFUL. Never saw our little girl look so calm and brave in the hands of a stranger, & they made sure we had all questions answered and all the information we needed to keep them healthy.
Called to get prices on vaccines and was on hold for 15 minutes getting an estimate

If you love your dog, do not bring them here.
These people are incompetent. They only see dollar signs and do not care about your dog at all. …
So grateful to VCA Ark for helping me get my kitty to Colombia next week! They were super fast, organized and kind. Highly recommend if you’re looking for international health certificates 🙏💛 …
$1,600 was the low-end quote to get my cat’s teeth cleaned. This (along with the pre-cleaning bloodwork) was double the amount I paid for the same thing the year before with VCA Ark. …
Dr Cieply is the best most thorough vet we’ve ever had. If you’re looking for someone to sit down and create a real plan of action with you, that’s who you need to see.

Healthy pet in injured one out!!
